title: Cinema Line
statementMd:
The new "Die Hard" movie has just been released! There are $*n*$ people at the cinema box office standing in a huge line. Each of them has a single $100$, $50$ or $25$ ruble bill. A "Die Hard" ticket costs $25$ rubles. Can the booking clerk sell a ticket to each person and give the change if he initially has no money and sells the tickets strictly in the order people follow in the line?

## Input

The first line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of people in the line. The next line contains $*n*$ integers, each of them equals $25$, $50$ or $100$ — the values of the bills the people have. The numbers are given in the order from the beginning of the line (at the box office) to the end of the line.

## Output

Print "`YES`" (without the quotes) if the booking clerk can sell a ticket to each person and give the change. Otherwise print "`NO`".
statementZhMd:
新上映的电影《虎胆龙威》！电影院售票处有 $*n*$ 个人排成一条长队。他们每个人都只有一张面额为 $100$、$50$ 或 $25$ 卢布的钞票。一张《虎胆龙威》电影票售价为 $25$ 卢布。售票员一开始没有任何零钱，并且必须严格按照队伍顺序售票；他能否为每个人售出一张票并找零？

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$——队伍中的人数。下一行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，每个整数均为 $25$、$50$ 或 $100$——人们持有的钞票面额。这些数字按照从队伍最前面（售票处）到队伍最后面的顺序给出。

## 输出格式

如果售票员能够为每个人售出一张票并正确找零，输出“`YES`”（不含引号）。否则输出“`NO`”。
